title: Scope the integration evidence-preservation claim to edge-level evidence arrays
description: The initial integration receipt has an unqualified all-original-evidence preservation claim. Its implementation checks only edge.evidence prefixes. Eight original native HH evidence occurrences in endpoint qualifiers are replaced by explicitly authorized primary-source construct qualifications. All185 native graph triples and edge-level evidence arrays survive; four corresponding activity edges retain the same native evidence locator in their edge arrays. This is an audit/provenance scope defect, not a biological error or unauthorized graph edit.

Write a scoped successor stating all_native_triples_and_edge_level_evidence_preserved=true and separately listing the eight replaced qualifier occurrences, their retained native source context and stronger primary construct replacements. Use the same distinction in the README and final report. No graph, native-author or primary-author frozen package change is needed.
